facts.fact: NOSi's catalogue of its e-government solutions says the Civilian ID System, working with SNIAC, collects and processes civil registry data on births, marriages, deaths and stillbirths in a stream linking the civil registries to other government systems, and registers the citizen's life events; the page gives no date, so the date is its published year, and no count of offices.

systems.owner: not stated; a NOSi solution working in conjunction with SNIAC
systems.tiers: civil registries, in a stream connecting them to other government information systems; no count of offices given

note: An undated catalogue page (published given as 2025, year precision). The Civilian ID System entry says events are processed and registered in a stream linking the civil registries to other government systems, but not whether the entry is made at the office at registration, so no fact is taken for how the record is made, nor for offices.
